title: Digital Ange: Dennou Tenshi SS
native_title: デジタル・アンジュ ～電脳天使ＳＳ～
overview:
Angels no one knows yet... A love no one knows yet.

Is it hard to be kind to people? Do you think love is stronger than weapons and arms? Your love will save us - and this Earth.

Digital Ange: Dennou Tenshi SS is an end-of-century pretty girl adventure, a reimagining of the earlier Dennou Tenshi game based on the Dennou Tenshi manga. You play as Takaya Hanabusa, whose name you can change, and meet a group of angels including Forsinia, Clairidel and Aindevel. Each angel has her own voice actress.

- Single-player adventure
- Voiced angel cast
- Memory backup

誰も、まだ知らない天使たち――…
誰も、まだ知らない――愛

人に優しくすることは、難しいですか? 愛は武器や兵器よりも強いと思いますか?

あなたの愛が、あたしたちを――この地球を救うのです。
